notes: Target weights are the frozen six-coin 2026 portfolio outputs; they are not re-optimized for a USD 1 million wallet.
ADV is a 30-day trailing mean of hourly close times base volume and is shifted one day.
Daily volatility is a trailing 30-day standard deviation of daily close returns and is shifted one day.
The square-root impact calculation is a capacity estimate, not an order-book replay.
No leverage above the original portfolio weights is introduced.
